quote: Where such traffic lanes have been marked, it shall be unlawful for the operator of any vehicle to fail or refuse to keep such vehicle within the boundaries of any such lane except when lawfully passing another vehicle or preparatory to making a lawful turning movement.

activation.condition: Marked traffic lanes apply to the vehicle and operator on the observed route.

obligation.description: Keep the full vehicle within the boundaries of a marked traffic lane, subject to the express passing and turn-preparation exceptions.

exceptions.effect: The lane-keeping obligation has the stated passing exception while its conditions hold.

exceptions.trigger: preparatory to making a lawful turning movement
exceptions.effect: The lane-keeping obligation has the stated turn-preparation exception while its conditions hold.
exceptions.source_clause: preparatory to making a lawful turning movement

timing.description: Observe the route through the marked-lane interval and any passing or turn preparation.

judgment_calls_needed.note: Passing lawfulness depends on separate applicable rules and the observed participant/maneuver facts.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: preparatory to making a lawful turning movement
judgment_calls_needed.note: Preparation and turn lawfulness depend on route intent evidence, movement and separate applicable rules.

parameter_refs.name: lane_boundary_clearance_m
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: signed observed full-body clearance in m

parameter_refs.name: turn_preparation_path
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: specified path geometry, no inferred intent

parameter_refs.name: lane_clearance_m
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: signed measured minimum full-body clearance in m

parameter_refs.name: lane_crossing_fraction
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: dimensionless requested lateral fraction from primary lane center toward adjacent center
